title: What AI model makes sense to use for Unity + Blender gamedev workflow?
author: Eshinio
selftext:
I havent dabbled in AI gamedev since Opus 4.6, and now there are a lot more, and better models out there. My main workflow will feature Unity and Blender, having the AI work with both via MCP. I currently use Astra on medium (Plus plan currently), using it as a planner/director for the game, leading three subagents within itself to handle different tasks. One agent is the Blender pro, one is the Unity pro and one is the QA/second pass specialist.

My question is if you think using Astra for this is overkill in general? I do not have much knowledge about Sol and Luna, but I just want to use whatever is most optimal in terms of usage limits, so I can get more done per session. Would love to hear feedback on this and what you guys use for your projects.

I also have Qwen 3.8 27B locally running, would it make sense having this perform some of the tasks, thereby saving usage on the Codex/Chatgpt plan?

I think what I'm generally missing is the understanding of what each of these models are capable of doing and so I just resort to the latest possible model...

comments.author: _DDark_
comments.body: Gotta be astra right now for that particular workflow.

comments.author: weverz
comments.body: Astra 6 is currently the undefeated champion. I don't know what happened do opus 5, but that model just pushes out garbage after garbage piles of code.
